reason: I already pay almost nothing for Bitrix24 and my team barely fills in a spreadsheet at the end of the day. Another tool means another fight to get them to use it, and I would only maybe click the free trial.
objection: My team will not learn another tool. And you have no customers to show me, so I would be the one testing it on my own people.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another company like mine in Uzbekistan using it daily, or you set it up and train my sales team in person during the trial and it actually replaces the end-of-day spreadsheet.
